The '''Sayormi Heartstriker''' was a small, bladed weapon utilized by the [[Sayormi]] monks of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], virtually identical in appearance to basic [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknucklers]]. It was named for its ability to break through the rib cage and pierce the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] of an enemy.

==Behind the scenes==
The Sayormi Heartstriker was a weapon that appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
